oneLiner: 用位移、速度、加速度描述物体位置随时间的变化。
oneLinerEn: Displacement, velocity and acceleration describe how position changes with time.
detail: 描述运动要先选参考系、再把物体看成质点——你坐着不动，可是北纬 30° 的地面正带你以约 400 m/s 向东转。位移只问初末位置、是矢量，路程才数走过的轨迹、是标量，绕 400 m 跑道跑一圈位移为零而路程是 400 m。平均速度是位移除以时间，瞬时速度是这段时间取得越短越趋近的那个比值，速率只取它的大小。加速度是对速度再做一次同样的处理，它与「跑得多快」无关：刚起步的货车速度很小而加速度不小，定速巡航的高铁速度很大而加速度近乎零；a 与 v 同号就加速、异号就减速，a 读作负数只说明它指向你定的正方向的反面，不代表在减速。单位换算是常年的失分点：60 km/h 等于 16.7 m/s，人步行约 1.4 m/s，手枪子弹出膛不过 300 m/s 上下，已是步行速度的两百倍。本条只管「用哪些量说运动」，具体公式在匀变速、平抛与圆周诸条里。
detailEn: To describe motion you first pick a reference frame and treat the body as a point mass - sitting still, you are being carried east at about 400 m/s at latitude 30°. Displacement asks only about start and end and is a vector; distance counts the actual trail and is a scalar, so one lap of a 400 m track gives zero displacement and 400 m of distance. Average velocity is displacement over time, instantaneous velocity is what that ratio approaches as the interval shrinks, and speed is its magnitude. Acceleration is the same trick applied to velocity and says nothing about how fast something goes: a truck pulling away has little speed but real acceleration, a cruise-controlled train has plenty of speed and almost none. Same sign as v means speeding up, opposite means slowing down, and a negative a only marks direction against the axis you chose. Unit conversion is the standing trap: 60 km/h is 16.7 m/s, walking is about 1.4 m/s, and a pistol bullet leaves the barrel near 300 m/s, some two hundred times a walking pace. This entry settles only what language to use; the formulas live in the uniformly accelerated, projectile and circular-motion entries.

oneLiner: 速度恒定、轨迹为直线的运动，位移与时间成正比。
oneLinerEn: Motion at constant velocity along a straight line; displacement is proportional to time.
detail: 物体沿直线且在任意相等的时间里位移都相等，就是匀速直线运动，只剩一个公式 x = vt。图像各说一半：x–t 图是一条倾斜直线、斜率就是速度，v–t 图是一条水平线、与时间轴围下的面积是位移。实验室用打点计时器造出并检验这种运动——电磁式接 50 Hz 交流、每 0.02 s 打一点，纸带上相邻点距相等即判定匀速，习惯上每 5 个点取一个计数点、对应时间间隔 0.1 s。概念上它是牛顿第一定律的正面形态：维持匀速不需要力，只有改变运动状态才需要力。「力是维持运动的原因」是摩擦造出的日常错觉，冰面与气垫导轨上滑块能滑很久、几乎不停，正是反证。现实中严格的匀速只是近似：平直轨道上定速巡航的列车、匀速传送带、以及下落到阻力与重力相等的收尾速度的雨滴，都归在这一档。
detailEn: A body moves uniformly along a straight line when its displacement is equal in every equal interval of time, which leaves one equation, x = vt. The two graphs split the story: x-t is a slanted straight line whose slope is the velocity, v-t is a horizontal line whose area against the axis is the displacement. The laboratory makes and checks such motion with a ticker timer - an electromagnetic one on a 50 Hz supply stamps a dot every 0.02 s, equally spaced dots certify uniform motion, and counting every fifth dot gives a convenient 0.1 s step. Conceptually this is Newton's first law seen from the front: nothing needs a force to keep going, only a change of motion does. The belief that force sustains motion is an illusion bred by friction, and a puck on an air track shows the opposite. Perfectly uniform motion is only an approximation in practice: a train cruising on straight level track, a conveyor belt, and a raindrop that has reached its terminal speed, with drag exactly balancing weight, all belong to this class.

oneLiner: 加速度恒定的直线运动，常用公式 v=v₀+at、x=v₀t+½at²、v²−v₀²=2ax。
oneLinerEn: Constant acceleration: v=v₀+at, x=v₀t+½at², v²−v₀²=2ax.
detail: 三条公式只服务同一前提：加速度恒定且沿直线，用哪条看缺什么——不求位移用 v = v₀+at，不含时间用 v²−v₀²=2ax，不碰末速度用 x = v₀t+½at²。两条推论常考：某段时间的平均速度等于这段中间时刻的瞬时速度 (v₀+v)/2，但只对匀变速成立；而中间位置的速度 √((v₀²+v²)/2) 总比中间时刻的速度大，因为速度小的那一段花的时间更多。纸带上求加速度用逐差法：相邻相等时间里的位移差是恒量 Δx = aT²，把六段分两组两两相减再平均，能压小偶然误差。自由落体是 a = g 的特例，g 约 9.8 m/s² 且随纬度与海拔微变（赤道约 9.780、两极约 9.832），落得太快不好计时，伽利略才用斜面「冲淡重力」。竖直上抛的上升与回落对称——回到抛点速率仍是 v₀、两段时间相等，把全程当成 a 取负的匀减速来处理比分段省事。符号纪律：先定一个正方向并守住它，负号只代表指向，不该读成「在变小」。式中 v₀、v 为初、末速度，a 为加速度，t 为时间，x 为位移。
detailEn: Three formulas serve one premise - constant acceleration along a line - and you pick by what is missing: v = v0 + at skips displacement, v² - v0² = 2ax skips time, x = v0*t + ½at² skips the final velocity. Two consequences are exam staples: the average velocity over a stretch equals the instantaneous velocity at the middle instant, true only for uniform acceleration; and the velocity at the middle of the distance, √((v0²+v²)/2), always exceeds the velocity at the middle of the time, because the body spends more time while going slower. On tape, successive displacements in equal times differ by the constant Δx = aT², and the standard way to squeeze out random error is to split six segments into two groups, subtract in pairs, then average. Free fall is the case a = g, about 9.8 m/s² and shifting slightly with latitude and height (roughly 9.780 at the equator, 9.832 at the poles); Galileo diluted gravity with an inclined plane because the fall itself was too quick to time. A ball thrown straight up is symmetric - it returns to the launch point at the launch speed after equal times - and treating the whole flight as one uniform acceleration with a taken as negative is shorter than splitting it. Keep one positive direction: a minus sign marks orientation, not a shrinking quantity. Symbols: v0 and v are initial and final velocity, a the acceleration, t the time, x the displacement.
example: 苹果下落约 0.5 s 后速度达约 4.9 m/s。
exampleEn: After ~0.5 s a falling apple reaches ~4.9 m/s.

oneLiner: 不受外力或合外力为零时，物体保持静止或匀速直线运动。
oneLinerEn: With no net force, an object stays at rest or in uniform motion.
detail: 这条定律给不出直接的实验证明——地球上找不到真正不受力的物体，它出自伽利略的理想斜面：小球沿一个斜面滚下，会冲上另一个斜面、几乎回到原来的高度；第二面放得越平，球要滚越远才够到那个高度；放到完全水平，球就永远滚下去。笛卡尔补上「方向也不变」，牛顿 1687 年在《自然哲学的数学原理》里把它列为第一定律，推翻了统治近两千年「运动需要力来维持」的看法。要点有三。惯性只由质量量度，与速度无关——同一辆车满载比空车难停，变的是质量不是速度。其次「不受力」与「合外力为零」等价，所以匀速直线是零合力所呈现的状态，而不是需要力去养着的状态。第三，解释现象别说「受到惯性作用」，惯性不是力，正确的说法是物体因惯性要保持原来的速度。安全带、头枕与货物捆扎，全是这条定律开出的工程账单。
detailEn: The first law cannot be proven by experiment directly - nothing on Earth is free of force - and it grew from Galileo's ideal incline: a ball rolling down one slope climbs the next to nearly its original height; flatten that second slope and it must roll farther to reach the same height; make it perfectly horizontal and the ball never stops. Descartes added the unchanged direction, and Newton set it down as the first law in the Principia of 1687, overturning the view, close to two thousand years old, that motion needs a cause to sustain it. Hold on to three points. Inertia is measured by mass alone, not by speed - a loaded truck is harder to stop than the same truck empty, and it is the mass that changed. Next, no force and perfectly balanced force come to the same thing, so uniform straight motion is what zero net force looks like, not a state a force must feed. Third, never say a body is 'acted on by inertia': inertia is not a force; the body keeps its velocity because that is its default. Seat belts, headrests and lashed cargo are all bills presented by this law.

oneLiner: 物体的加速度与合外力成正比、与质量成反比：F=ma。
oneLinerEn: Acceleration is proportional to net force and inversely to mass: F=ma.
detail: F = ma 要读作「合外力等于质量乘以加速度」，重音落在「合」与「即时」：先把所有外力按矢量合成一个和，它定下的加速度就与和同向、随和立刻改变，力一撤 a 归零而物体照旧匀速下去。力的单位正是这么定的——使 1 kg 获得 1 m/s² 的力为 1 N，于是 kg·m/s² 与 N 可互相检验。解题的两个视角：几个物体一起动时先当整体求出 a，再隔离其中一个求内力，别把内力混进整体方程。两个易混点：把 a 与 v 挂钩是错的（力大不代表速度大，上抛的小球在最高点 v = 0 而 a 仍是 g）；把「视重」当重力也是错的（电梯加速上升时台秤读数变大即超重、加速下降时变小即失重，变的只是支持力 N，g 没有动）。适用范围须写明：宏观低速才成立，接近光速要换相对论形式（那时更基本的是 F = dp/dt），微观粒子另有量子规律。式中 F 为合外力（单位 N）、m 为质量（kg）、a 为加速度（m/s²）。
detailEn: Read F = ma as 'net force equals mass times acceleration', with the stress on net and on instant: add the external forces as vectors first, and the acceleration points along that sum and changes with it the moment it changes - take the force away and a drops to zero while the body carries on at constant velocity. The unit is defined by the law: 1 N is the force giving 1 kg an acceleration of 1 m/s², which is how kg·m/s² and newtons cross-check. Two working habits for problems: for bodies moving together treat them as one system to find a, then isolate one to find the internal force, and never let internal forces into the system equation. Two confusions to clear: linking a to v (a large force is not a large speed - a thrown ball at its highest point has v = 0 while a is still g), and taking apparent weight for gravity (a scale reads high in an upward accelerating lift and low in a downward one, but only the support force N changed, g did not). State the boundary too: the form holds for slow everyday bodies; near light speed you need the relativistic version, where F = dp/dt is the deeper statement, and microscopic particles follow quantum rules. Symbols: F is the net force in newtons, m the mass in kilograms, a the acceleration in m/s².

oneLiner: 作用力与反作用力大小相等、方向相反、作用在不同物体上。
oneLinerEn: Action and reaction are equal, opposite, and act on different bodies.
detail: 两物体间的作用力与反作用力总是等值、反向、共线，而且同性质、同时产生同时消失。它与「一对平衡力」的分别是必考点：平衡力作用在同一物体上、可以相互抵消，作用力与反作用力分属两个物体、永远谈不上抵消。两个误解当场消掉。其一，马拉车不是因为「马的拉力大于车回给的拉力」——那对力大小恒等；马能前进是马蹄向后蹬地、地把马向前推，而地给马向前的力大于车受到的阻力，胜负写在各物体所受的外力上，不在这一对相互作用里。其二，火箭不靠推空气：它把废气向后高速抛出，废气给火箭向前的反作用力，真空中同样存在，这正是太空里能变轨、能调姿的原因；喷气飞机、划桨、人走路都是同一笔账。用两只弹簧秤对拉，无论哪一方更「主动」，两边读数始终一样——这既是定律的演示，也是测力计读数的依据。
detailEn: Action and reaction between two bodies are always equal, opposite and collinear, of the same kind of force, born and gone at the same instant. The contrast with a balanced pair is the point usually tested: balanced forces act on one body and cancel, while an action-reaction pair acts on two different bodies and can never cancel each other. Two misconceptions clear away at once. A horse does not pull a cart because its pull exceeds the cart's reaction - those two are always equal; the horse advances because it kicks the ground backward and the ground pushes it forward harder than the drag on the cart, so the verdict is written on each body's external forces, not inside that pair. A rocket does not push against the air: it throws exhaust backward and the exhaust pushes it forward, and that thrust exists in vacuum, which is exactly how a spacecraft turns or trims its attitude; jet engines, oars and walking are the same transaction. Hook two spring scales together and pull - however one side 'attacks', the readings stay identical, which is both a demonstration of the law and the reason a force meter can be trusted.

oneLiner: 阻碍相对运动或相对运动趋势的力，分静摩擦与滑动摩擦。
oneLinerEn: A force opposing relative motion or its tendency; static or kinetic.
detail: 摩擦力头上写着「相对」二字：它阻碍的是两个接触面之间的相对滑动或其趋势，不是物体本身的运动。静摩擦是被动力，大小由平衡条件决定（有加速度时改由牛顿第二定律定），可在 0 到最大静摩擦之间随外力取值，方向与相对运动趋势相反——判断趋势的常用手法是「假想接触面光滑，它会往哪边滑」。一旦滑动，f = μN，μ 是动摩擦因数、没有单位，只由材料与粗糙程度决定，在近似意义上与接触面积和速度大小无关；N 是正压力，不一定等于重力：斜面上 N = mg cosθ，别的力只要有竖直分量就会改动它。最大静摩擦略高于滑动摩擦，所以推重柜子最费劲的是「起步」那一下。以滚代滑省力的量级差很大，钢轮对钢轨的滚动阻力系数约 0.001，比干钢面滑动摩擦的 0.5 上下小两个数量级。两个易错处：摩擦力也能做动力，传送带靠摩擦把货物从静止带到共速、人走路时地面给脚的摩擦向前；算摩擦生热要乘相对位移，Q = f·Δs 里的 Δs 是两表面之间滑过的距离（也就是划痕长度），不是任一物体相对地面的位移。式中 f 为滑动摩擦力，μ 为动摩擦因数，N 为接触面正压力。
detailEn: Friction carries the word relative in its own definition: it opposes relative sliding between the two surfaces in contact, or the tendency of it, not the motion of the body. Static friction is reactive - its value is fixed by the balance condition, or by Newton's second law once there is acceleration, free to take anything from zero up to its maximum, pointing against the tendency you test by asking which way the surfaces would slip if they were smooth. Once sliding, f = μN, with μ a dimensionless coefficient set by material and roughness and, to good approximation, independent of contact area and speed; N is the pressing force, which need not equal weight - on a slope N = mg cosθ, and any vertical component of another force shifts it. Maximum static friction sits a little above the kinetic value, which is why a heavy cabinet is hardest exactly at the start. Replacing sliding by rolling is cheap in a way the numbers show: steel wheel on steel rail has a rolling resistance coefficient around 0.001 against a kinetic value near 0.5 for dry steel. Two traps: friction can be the driving force, since a conveyor belt accelerates its load by friction and the ground pushes your foot forward by friction when you walk; and the heat produced is Q = f times the relative sliding distance - the length of the scratch between the surfaces - not either body's displacement over the ground. Symbols: f is kinetic friction, μ the coefficient, N the normal (pressing) force.

oneLiner: 物体受多个共点力而静止或匀速时，合外力为零。
oneLinerEn: When balanced by concurrent forces, the net force is zero.
detail: 平衡条件是合外力为零，而这等价于两条方程：ΣFx = 0 且 ΣFy = 0，所以正交分解是默认动作——先选定研究对象，再画受力图，把斜着的力拆进两根轴。只受三个力时有捷径：三条作用线必共点（三力汇交），把三个力首尾相接就得到一个闭合三角形，于是相似三角形与纯几何常比列方程更快。动态平衡另有一套路子：一个力大小方向都不变、一个只变方向、剩下的随之调整，把可变的力沿矢量三角形滑过去，谁增大谁减小一眼可见，这类题在「缓慢拉起」「半圆形支架」一类装置上反复出现。约束模型要分清真绳与轻杆：绳只能沿自身提供拉力，跨过光滑滑轮的同一根绳张力处处相等（活结），打了结则两侧张力可以不等（死结）；轻杆却能拉、能压、还能给侧向力，其弹力方向不必沿杆。整体法与隔离法可自由切换，但一次只能对一个对象列方程，也别把内力写进方程里。
detailEn: Equilibrium means zero net force, which is two equations, ΣFx = 0 and ΣFy = 0, so resolving into perpendicular axes is the default move: choose the object, draw the free-body diagram, split every slanted force between the axes. With only three forces there is a shortcut - their lines of action must meet at one point, and laid head to tail they close into a triangle, so similar triangles and plain geometry often beat algebra. Dynamic equilibrium wants a different reflex: hold one force fixed, let a second change only in direction, and slide the remaining force along the vector triangle to see which grows and which shrinks; this is the pattern behind the 'pulled up slowly' and 'semicircular frame' problems. Sort out the constraint models: a rope can only pull along itself, and a single rope over a frictionless pulley has equal tension throughout (a running knot), whereas a tied knot permits different tensions on the two sides; a light rod can pull, push or load sideways, and its force need not lie along the rod. Switch freely between the whole system and one isolated body, but write equations for a single object at a time and keep internal forces out of them.

oneLiner: 速度方向与合力不在一直线时做曲线运动；平抛是水平匀速加竖直自由落体。
oneLinerEn: Curved motion occurs when velocity and net force are not collinear; a projectile combines horizontal uniform and vertical free-fall motion.
detail: 做曲线运动的条件是合力与速度不在同一直线上，轨迹向合力一侧弯：合力指向凹侧、速度沿切线，这两条写反，图像题就全错。处理办法是「拆成互不干扰的直线运动」——演示实验里蜡块在注水的玻璃管中匀速上升，同时随管水平匀速移动，合起来仍是直线；把水平那段改成变速，轨迹就弯成抛物线，这同时说明了分运动的等时性与独立性。平抛取水平 x = v₀t、竖直 y = ½gt²，两式一消去 t 得轨迹 y = gx²/(2v₀²)；任意时刻速度偏向角 α 与位移偏向角 θ 满足 tanα = 2tanθ，这个二倍关系是选择与填空的常客。等时性还能反过来做演示：平抛出去的小球与同高同时自由下落的小球同时落地（平抛竖落仪），说明竖直分运动与水平快慢无关。同一套数学搬到匀强电场里就是带电粒子的「类平抛」，示波管与喷墨打印靠它偏转束流。不计阻力时，等高落地的抛体射程在 45° 取得极大，40° 与 50° 的射程精确相等——互补角共用同一个 sin2θ，这正是「两个角度命中同一目标」的来源。
detailEn: A body curves whenever the net force is not along its velocity, and the path bends toward that force: the force points to the concave side while the velocity lies along the tangent - reverse these two and every graph question is lost. The method is to split motion into independent straight-line parts. In the classic demonstration a wax block rising steadily inside a water-filled tube that is slid sideways at a steady pace still traces a straight line, while making the horizontal part accelerated bends the path into a parabola, which shows at once that the components are simultaneous and independent. For a horizontal throw take x = v0*t and y = ½gt²; eliminating t gives the path y = gx²/(2v0²), and at any instant the velocity angle α and displacement angle θ obey tanα = 2tanθ - that factor of two is a favourite of examiners. Equality of time works in reverse as a demo: a ball launched sideways and a ball dropped from the same height at the same moment land together (the projectile-and-free-fall apparatus), proving the vertical part ignores horizontal speed. The same algebra moved into a uniform electric field is the projectile-like deflection of a charged particle, which is how cathode-ray tubes and inkjet printers steer their beam. Neglecting drag, range on level ground peaks at 45°, and 40° and 50° land exactly alike because complementary angles share one sin2θ - which is why two angles can hit one target.

oneLiner: 匀速圆周运动由指向圆心的向心力提供：F=mv²/r=mω²r。
oneLinerEn: Uniform circular motion needs a centripetal force toward the center: F=mv²/r=mω²r.
detail: 先理清描述量：线速度 v = 2πr/T、角速度 ω = 2π/T，两者由 v = ωr 挂钩；向心加速度 a = v²/r = ω²r = 4π²r/T²，它只改速度方向、不改大小。最要紧的一句是「向心力」按效果取名字，不是一种新来的力，所以每道题都得回答谁提供它：随转盘转的物块靠静摩擦，圆锥摆靠绳拉力与重力的合力，卫星靠引力，火车在略高的外轨上转弯靠重力与支持力的合力——在设计速度下轮缘几乎不挤压轨道。竖直平面内的圆周分两种模型：绳（或内侧轨道）只能拉，最高点速率不得低于 √(gr)，再小绳就松、车就脱轨；杆（或圆管）既能拉又能撑，最高点速率可以为零。当供给小于所需的 mv²/r，物体就做离心运动，洗衣机脱水与砂轮超速时飞出的碎块都记在这笔账上。最后一条纪律：在惯性系里别写「物体受到离心力」，那是只有在非惯性系里才需要引入的惯性力，写出来就把受力分析搞乱了。式中 m 为质量，v 为线速度，ω 为角速度，r 为圆周半径。
detailEn: Sort the descriptors first: v = 2πr/T and ω = 2π/T, joined by v = ωr, with centripetal acceleration a = v²/r = ω²r = 4π²r/T², which turns the velocity around without changing its size. The essential sentence is that 'centripetal force' names an effect, not a fresh kind of force, so every problem must answer who supplies it: static friction for a block riding a turntable, the resultant of tension and weight for a conical pendulum, gravity for a satellite, and the resultant of weight and the track's support for a train turning on a raised outer rail - at the design speed the wheel flanges press almost nothing. Vertical circles split into two models: a string or an inner rail can only pull, so the speed at the top cannot fall below √(gr) or the string goes slack and the vehicle leaves the track; a rod or a tube can also push, so zero speed at the top is allowed. When the supply falls short of the needed mv²/r the body swings outward - a spin dryer wringing clothes and the shards of an over-speeding grinding wheel are on this account. One discipline: in an inertial frame never write that the body 'experiences a centrifugal force', which is a device used only in non-inertial frames and it wrecks the force analysis. Symbols: m is mass, v linear speed, ω angular speed, r the radius.

oneLiner: 任意两质点相互吸引：F=G·m₁m₂/r²。
oneLinerEn: Any two masses attract: F=G·m₁m₂/r².
detail: F = G·m₁m₂/r² 的前提是质点或均匀球体——球体对外的效果等价于全部质量集中在球心，这才让定律能用于行星与地球；r 是两质点间距，地面附近的物体取 r 约等于地球半径 R。G ≈ 6.67×10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg² 小得离谱：两个 1 kg 的球相距 1 m，彼此的引力只有 6.67×10⁻¹¹ 牛，比托起其中一个所需的重力小约十一个数量级。引力在微观世界毫无存在感、在天文尺度上独裁，原因正在它是长程的、只会相加而从不抵消。这个 G 由后人从卡文迪许 1797 至 1798 年的扭秤数据换算而来，他本人只说「称量地球」——测出地球平均密度约为水的 5.5 倍。定律的历史功绩是把苹果与月亮并成一件事：月球轨道半径约为 60 个地球半径，若引力按 1/r² 衰减，月球的「下落加速度」就该是地面 g 的 1/3600、即 0.0027 m/s² 上下，而由 (2π/T)²r 算出的月球向心加速度正是这个数——这一步检验比公式本身更能说明它为什么叫「万有」，教科书里把这一步称作月—地检验。工程上最省事的替换是黄金代换 GM = gR²：地面重力与天体质量被缝成一个可测量；再由卫星的 T 与 r 用 M = 4π²r³/(GT²) 称出任一天体的质量与密度。g 随高度按 g(h) = g₀(R/(R+h))² 衰减，400 km 高的轨道上仍有约 8.7 m/s²，所以舱内漂浮不是因为没了引力，而是飞船与里面的人在共同做同一份自由落体（视重的口径见牛顿第二定律条）。边界须写明：弱场低速足够，水星近日点每世纪多出约 43 角秒的进动对不上这个式子，那要交给广义相对论。式中 G 为引力常数，m₁、m₂ 为两物体质量，r 为两质点间距。
detailEn: The formula F = G m₁m₂/r² presumes point masses or uniform spheres - a sphere acts from outside as if all its mass sat at its centre, which is what lets the law be used on planets and Earth - and r is the separation of the two points, so near the ground r is about Earth's radius. G ≈ 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg² is absurdly small: two 1 kg balls a metre apart pull on each other with 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N, some eleven orders of magnitude below the force needed to hold up one of them. Gravity is irrelevant in the micro world and dictator of the astronomical one precisely because it is long-ranged, only ever adding and never cancelling. The number was converted later from Cavendish's torsion-balance data of 1797-1798, who described his own result only as 'weighing the Earth' - a mean density about 5.5 times that of water. The law's historical triumph was to make apple and moon one case: the Moon sits about 60 Earth radii away, so if gravity falls off as 1/r² its 'falling acceleration' should be the ground value divided by 3600, about 0.0027 m/s², and (2π/T)²r gives exactly that - the check, more than the formula, is why the law calls itself universal - the textbook names it the Earth-Moon test. The handiest substitute in practice is the gold exchange GM = gR², which stitches surface gravity and planetary mass into one measurable; then a satellite's T and r yield any body's mass and density through M = 4π²r³/(GT²). Gravity thins with height as g(h) = g₀(R/(R+h))², and at 400 km it is still about 8.7 m/s², so floating inside a cabin is not the absence of gravity but the ship and its occupants making the same free fall together (for apparent weight see the second-law entry). State the boundary too: weak fields and slow speeds are fine, but the roughly 43 arcseconds per century by which Mercury's perihelion outruns this formula belongs to general relativity. Symbols: G the gravitational constant, m₁ and m₂ the two masses, r the distance between the point masses.

term: 天体运动与开普勒定律
oneLiner: 行星沿椭圆轨道绕日，面积速度恒定，周期平方正比于半长轴立方。
oneLinerEn: Planets follow ellipses; equal areas in equal times; T²∝a³.
detail: 三条定律是同一次观测的三次抽象，各管一件事。第一定律说轨道是椭圆、太阳在其中一个焦点上：近日点距离 a(1−e)、远日点 a(1+e)，e 是偏心率，圆只是 e = 0 的特例，所以别把「轨道半径」当成不变量。第二定律说相等时间里扫过相等面积，即面积速度恒定，于是行星在近日点快、远日点慢；今天知道它的实质是角动量守恒（引力是有心力、力矩为零），但开普勒手里只有第谷留下的观测数。第三定律 T² = (4π²/GM)·a³ 才是真正能用的一条：比值只由中心天体决定，因此绕日的行星共用一个常数、绕地的卫星共用另一个，跨中心天体去比就是错。它的用处有三——由 a 与 T 反算中心天体的质量；给定周期定轨道高度（地球同步卫星取一个恒星日约 23 小时 56 分，解出 a 约 4.2 万公里、离地约 3.6 万公里，通信与气象卫星就钉在这里）；以及判断变轨之后周期的长短。史实口径与人物条一致：第谷二十年肉眼观测攒下的数据里，火星轨道有 8 角分放不下圆轨道，开普勒因此丢掉延续两千年的圆形执念，1609 年给出前两条、1619 年给出第三条；1687 年牛顿再从万有引力把这三条从理论上导出——顺序不能记反，开普勒是观测的归纳，牛顿是动力学的解释。适用边界也要交代：它是二体近似，真实太阳系里行星互扰产生摄动，天王星轨道的残差正是 1846 年海王星「被算出来而非被看见」的依据。式中 T 为公转周期，a 为椭圆轨道半长轴（T²∝a³）。
detailEn: The three laws are three abstractions of one body of observations, each doing a different job. The first says the orbit is an ellipse with the Sun at one focus: perihelion distance a(1−e), aphelion a(1+e), e being the eccentricity, and a circle is merely the case e = 0 - so never treat orbital radius as a constant. The second says equal areas in equal times, the areal speed being constant, so a planet moves fastest near the Sun and slowest far off; we now know its substance is conservation of angular momentum (gravity is a central force, hence zero torque), though Kepler had only Tycho's numbers in hand. The third, T² = (4π²/GM)a³, is the one actually usable: the ratio is fixed by the central body alone, so planets about the Sun share one constant and satellites about the Earth another, and comparing across central bodies is simply wrong. Three uses follow - recover the central mass from a and T; fix an orbital altitude from a chosen period (a geostationary satellite, taking a sidereal day of about 23 h 56 min, lands on a of roughly 42,000 km, some 36,000 km above the surface, which is where comms and weather satellites are nailed down); and judge how the period changes after a maneuver. Keep the history consistent with the biography entry: among the twenty years of naked-eye data Tycho amassed, the martian orbit missed the circle by 8 arcminutes, so Kepler gave up two millennia of circular devotion, publishing the first two laws in 1609 and the third in 1619; Newton then derived all three from universal gravitation in 1687 - and the order must not be reversed, since Kepler generalises from data while Newton explains. State the limit as well: these are two-body approximations, and mutual perturbations rattle the real system - the residual in Uranus's orbit is what made Neptune counted rather than seen in 1846. Symbols: T the orbital period, a the semi-major axis of the ellipse (T² ∝ a³).

oneLiner: 环绕、脱离、逃逸三档最小速度：约 7.9、11.2、16.7 km/s。
oneLinerEn: The three minimum speeds—orbital, escape, and beyond—about 7.9, 11.2, 16.7 km/s.
detail: 第一宇宙速度 7.9 km/s 是近地圆轨道的环绕速度，也是最小发射速度；第二 11.2 km/s 即逃逸速度，可挣脱地球引力成为绕太阳的人造行星；第三 16.7 km/s 可离开太阳系。三档数值都随中心天体的质量与半径而变，月球、火星探测器须按所在天体重新计算。三档速度各有出处：第一是 √(GM/R)，第二恰是它的 √2 倍即 √(2GM/R)，两者都以「贴地飞行、不计大气与山高」为前提；第三 16.7 km/s 要先挣脱地球、再借上地球公转的约 30 km/s，发射方向选在公转同向才最省。真实火箭也不是直线冲到 7.9 就停手：入轨的总速度增量约 9.4 km/s，多出的 1.5 km/s 上下是克服重力损失与空气阻力的代价，姿态因此先竖直起飞、再逐渐把倾角压平（重力转弯）。补一组可对照的数：400 km 圆轨道上速度约 7.67 km/s、周期约 90 分钟、g 仍有约 8.7 m/s²；换个天体数字全变，月球环绕约 1.7、逃逸约 2.4，火星环绕约 3.6、逃逸约 5.0，单位都是 km/s。
detailEn: The first (7.9 km/s) is the low circular-orbit speed and also the minimum launch speed; the second (11.2 km/s, hence also called the escape velocity) breaks free of Earth to orbit the Sun; the third (16.7 km/s) leaves the Solar System. All scale with the host body's mass and radius, so lunar and Martian probes recompute them per world. Each tier has its own source: the first is √(GM/R), the second exactly √2 times it, and both presuppose skimming flight with no atmosphere and no mountains; the third, 16.7 km/s, must first escape the Earth and then spend the roughly 30 km/s already supplied by the planet's orbit, so launching along the direction of that motion is the cheapest. A real rocket does not simply fly up to 7.9 and stop - the total velocity increment to reach orbit is about 9.4 km/s, the extra 1.5 km/s or so paying for gravity losses and drag, which is why the vehicle climbs first and then gradually tips its trajectory over (a gravity turn). A comparable set of numbers: in a 400 km circular orbit the speed is about 7.67 km/s, the period roughly 90 minutes, and g is still near 8.7 m/s². Change worlds and every figure moves - orbit speed about 1.7 and escape about 2.4 km/s for the Moon, about 3.6 and 5.0 km/s for Mars.

oneLiner: 加速抬轨、减速降轨——一次喷发重设圆轨半径与周期。
oneLinerEn: Speed up to climb, slow down to descend—a burn resets orbit radius and period.
detail: 卫星在原圆轨道加速，所需向心力大于当前引力供给，遂做离心运动抬升到更高轨道；稳定到新圆轨后线速度反而变小（v 随 r 增大而减小），“高处反而更慢”是常考易错点。霍曼转移用两次短脉冲最省燃料地进出高轨，交会对接则需在低轨加速追赶、再做相位微调。这一条最该记牢的账是「高轨更慢，机械能却更高」：轨道能量 E = −GMm/(2r)，r 越大越接近零，而动能 ½mv² 随 1/r 减小，差额全存在势能里——所以抬轨一定要烧燃料，降轨反而能白捡速度。霍曼转移的两次脉冲都是正向（第一次进椭圆、到远地点再加速才圆化），返程则两次反向减速。交会不能直线追：在同一轨道上加速会抬轨变慢、把距离拉开，追赶者须先在低轨按相位角提前出发，再择点抬轨汇合。回家同样是减速——把近地点压进大气层，之后交给阻力继续降高，一次「刹车」才是返回的钥匙。地月之间的经典霍曼转移约 5 天，阿波罗走更快的窗口只用 3 天上下。
detailEn: A prograde burn makes the satellite need more centripetal force than gravity supplies, so it swings out to a higher orbit; once circularized its speed is actually lower (v falls as r grows)—“higher yet slower” is a classic trap. A Hohmann transfer raises or lowers an orbit with two impulsive burns at minimum fuel, while rendezvous means accelerating in a lower chase orbit then trimming phase.The account worth remembering is 'higher yet slower, but with more mechanical energy': orbital energy is E = −GMm/(2r), which rises toward zero as r grows while the kinetic energy ½mv² falls with 1/r, the whole difference being stored as potential - so climbing always burns fuel, whereas falling hands speed back. Both burns of a Hohmann transfer are prograde (the first enters the ellipse, the second circularises at apogee), and the return does the reverse twice over. Rendezvous cannot be a straight chase: accelerating in the same orbit lifts and slows you, opening the gap, so the chaser starts low, arrives by phase angle and only then raises the orbit to meet. Going home is a deceleration too - drop the perigee into the atmosphere and let drag do the rest, since one brake, not one push, is the key to re-entry. The classical Earth-Moon Hohmann transfer takes about five days, while Apollo flew a faster window of roughly three.

oneLiner: 两颗星绕共同质心转动，周期相同、轨道半径与质量成反比。
oneLinerEn: Two stars orbit their common centre of mass—same period, radii inversely proportional to mass.
detail: 双星间的万有引力提供各自绕质心的向心力，故两者角速度与周期相同，满足 m₁r₁ = m₂r₂——质量大的离质心更近、转的圆更小。天狼星 B、食双星由此称出质量；X 射线双星与引力波双黑洞并合同属这一框架，使双星成为称量天体的主法。观测上有三条互补的称量路子：目视双星量出角轨道与周期，食双星由掩食补出轨道倾角与两星半径，光谱双星靠多普勒视向速度曲线给出质量函数，三者叠起来才拿到真实质量。天狼星 B 正是这样落定的——1862 年看见它暗弱的伴星，1915 年测出其光谱，才知是一颗密度高得离谱的白矮星（与恒星演化条口径一致）。脉冲双星 PSR B1913+16（1974 年由赫尔斯与泰勒发现）的周期在不断变短，缩短量与引力波带走能量的预言吻合到千分之几，两人因此获 1993 年诺贝尔物理学奖；LIGO 2015 年看到的双黑洞并合是同一条轨道衰减的最后几秒，频率上扬的那段「啁啾」就是把两颗黑洞的轨道同时按开普勒定律与引力辐射算出来的。最常见的错在符号：公式里的 r 是两星之间的距离，各自绕质心的轨道半径是 r₁、r₂，满足 r₁ + r₂ = r，把 r 当成轨道半径会整题算错。
detailEn: Their mutual gravity supplies each star's centripetal force, so both share one angular speed and period with m₁r₁ = m₂r₂—heavier stars sit closer to the barycentre on smaller circles. Sirius B and eclipsing binaries are weighed this way, as are X-ray binaries and merging black-hole waves, making binaries the primary method for measuring stellar masses.Three observational routes complement each other: visual binaries give the angular orbit and period, eclipsing binaries add the inclination and both radii, and spectroscopic binaries give a mass function from the Doppler radial-velocity curve - only stacked together do they yield real masses. Sirius B settled this way: its faint companion was seen in 1862 and its spectrum measured in 1915, revealing an absurdly dense white dwarf (consistent with the stellar-evolution entry). The pulsar pair PSR B1913+16, found by Hulse and Taylor in 1974, has a period that keeps shrinking, matching the energy carried off by gravitational waves to within a few parts per thousand - their 1993 Nobel prize - and the binary black-hole merger LIGO heard in 2015 is the last few seconds of that same decay, its rising chirp being the orbit computed from Kepler's laws and gravitational radiation at once. The commonest slip is notation: r in the formula is the separation of the two stars, while their own radii about the barycentre are r₁ and r₂ with r₁ + r₂ = r - read r as an orbit radius and the whole problem goes wrong.

oneLiner: 功 W=Fs·cosθ（力在位移方向的分量乘位移）；功率 P=W/t。
oneLinerEn: Work W=Fs·cosθ; power P=W/t.
detail: 功的定义只有一句：W = Fs·cosθ，力在位移方向上的分量乘以位移。它是标量，正负不问方向而问这个角色是动力还是阻力——阻力做负功时常说成「克服某力做功若干」。三种情形下不做功：没受力、没位移、力与位移垂直；提着水桶水平走路，竖直的提力对桶做功为零，腰酸来自肌肉反复收缩而不是物理功。功率有两种问法：P = W/t 是这段时间的平均功率，P = Fv 是这一瞬间的实际功率，铭牌上的额定功率就是允许长时间输出的上限。由此两件事一目了然：汽车以额定功率爬坡必须换低速挡，因为 v 降下来 F 才升得上去；「一马力」定得比马的实际输出偏高——瓦特为了把蒸汽机卖给矿主，把它定为 550 英尺·磅每秒（约 746 W），而马长时间拉动的实际功率低于这个数，公制马力又取 735.5 W。量级感：把 20 kg 的箱子抬高 1 m 约做 200 J，60 kg 的人上一层 3 m 高的楼约 1.8 kJ，而人能持续输出的功率不过百瓦量级。最后一条与摩擦力条分工：算功一律用物体相对地面的位移，算摩擦生热用两表面之间的相对滑动距离；一对相互作用力的功之和要看有无相对滑动——静摩擦时恰为零，滑动时之和为负、绝对值就是产生的热。式中 W 为功（J），F 为作用力，s 为位移，θ 为力与位移夹角，P 为功率（W），t 为时间。
detailEn: Work has one definition: W = Fs cosθ, the force component along the displacement times that displacement. It is a scalar, and its sign asks not about direction but about role - a negative work is usually phrased as 'doing work against' that force. Three situations do no work at all: no force, no displacement, or force perpendicular to displacement; carry a bucket level across a room and your upward pull does zero work on it, while the ache in your arm comes from muscles contracting again and again, not from physics. Power asks two different questions: P = W/t is the average over an interval, P = Fv is the actual value at an instant, and the rated power on a machine's plate is what it may sustain for hours. Two everyday facts follow. A car climbing at rated power must shift down, because only a smaller v buys a larger F. And one horsepower was set above what a horse really delivers: to sell steam engines Watt defined it as 550 foot-pounds per second (about 746 W), while a horse pulling for hours gives less - the metric horsepower counts 735.5 W. For scale: lifting a 20 kg box by 1 m is about 200 J, a 60 kg person climbing one 3 m flight is about 1.8 kJ, and a human sustains only on the order of 100 W. One division of labour with the friction entry: work always uses displacement relative to the ground, while frictional heat uses the relative sliding distance between the two surfaces - and the two works of an action-reaction pair sum to exactly zero when there is no slipping, and to minus the heat generated when there is. Symbols: W work in joules, F the force, s the displacement, theta the angle between them, P power in watts, t the time.

oneLiner: 动能 Eₖ=½mv²；合外力做功等于动能变化：W=ΔEₖ。
oneLinerEn: Kinetic energy Eₖ=½mv²; net work equals its change: W=ΔEₖ.
detail: 动能 Eₖ = ½mv² 是标量，而且随参考系而变：车厢里以 10 m/s 走向车头的乘客，对车厢的动能小、对地面还得叠上车速——默认取地面为参考系，正是为了避免这笔糊涂账。速度是平方进入的，所以翻倍的速度带来四倍的动能，限速与「保持车距」的物理根据就在这里：同样路面下刹车距离 s = v²/(2μg)，100 km/h 的刹车距离约为 50 km/h 的四倍；把一辆 1000 kg 的车加速到 100 km/h，要付出约 39 万焦（½×1000×27.8²）。动能定理 W_合 = ΔEₖ 的价值在于它是标量方程：不必问力怎么变、轨迹怎么弯，把各力的功代数相加即可，因此变力做功、曲线运动、穿透深度、制动距离都归它管，而换成 F = ma 就得先解矢量方程。三个易错处：一是 W 必须是合外力的总功，漏掉一段摩擦或一段重力就错；二是动能不变不等于没有力做功——匀速上升的电梯里牵引力做正功、重力做等量负功，总和才为零；三是它只在惯性系里成立、且限宏观低速，高速时动能要换成 (γ−1)mc²。式中 Eₖ 为动能，m 为质量，v 为速率，W 为合外力做的功。
detailEn: Kinetic energy E_k = ½mv² is a scalar and it depends on the frame: a passenger walking forward at 10 m/s inside a carriage has little energy relative to the carriage and rather more relative to the ground, which is exactly why the ground frame is the silent default. Speed enters squared, so doubling it quadruples the energy - the physics behind speed limits and two-second gaps: on the same surface the braking distance is s = v²/(2μg), so stopping from 100 km/h takes about four times the distance needed at 50 km/h, and bringing a 1000 kg car up to 100 km/h costs roughly 390 kJ (½ × 1000 × 27.8²). The theorem W_net = ΔE_k is worth learning because it is a scalar equation: never mind how the force varies or how the path bends, just add up the works algebraically. Changing forces, curved paths, penetration depth and stopping distance all fall to it, where F = ma would first demand a vector equation. Three traps. The W must be the total work of the net force - leave out one stretch of friction or one of gravity and the answer is wrong. Constant kinetic energy does not mean no force is doing work: in a lift rising at steady speed the cable does positive work and gravity does exactly as much negative work, and only the sum vanishes. And the theorem holds only in inertial frames and at non-relativistic speeds, where energy becomes (γ - 1)mc². Symbols: E_k kinetic energy, m mass, v speed, W the net work done.

oneLiner: 物体因高度而具有的能量：Eₚ=mgh。
oneLinerEn: Energy due to height: Eₚ=mgh.
detail: 重力势能 Eₚ = mgh 有三件必须说清的事。第一，它属于系统而不属于物体：这笔能量归「物体—地球」共有，把势能写成物体单独持有的东西是概念性错误。第二，它依赖零势能面的选取，因而可正可负——负号不代表没有势能，只代表它在所选面的下方；与选取无关的永远是差值 ΔEₚ，过程用掉的也只是差。第三，重力做功与路径无关、只由初末高度差决定，W_G = −ΔEₚ，这正是「势能」概念得以成立的条件；对照之下摩擦力做功沿路径一路累加，圈数越多耗得越多，所以不存在「摩擦势能」。弹性势能 Eₚ = ½kx² 走的是同一套逻辑：弹力随形变线性变化，F–x 图下的三角形面积就是功（k 为劲度系数，超出弹性限度后不再线性）。量级感：60 kg 的人登上 100 m 高的楼顶，势能增加约 5.9×10⁴ 焦，与一块方糖氧化放出的化学能同量级；水库蓄满后每立方米水下落 100 m 交出约 9.8×10⁵ 焦，水力发电吃的就是这笔差。最后一条边界须写明：mgh 只在高度远小于地球半径时成立，再高就得回到引力的严格式 −GMm/r。式中 Eₚ 为重力势能，m 为质量，g 为重力加速度，h 为相对零势能面的高度。
detailEn: Gravitational potential energy E_p = mgh has three things to settle. First, it belongs to a system, not to the object: the energy is jointly held by the object-and-Earth, and writing it as something a body carries alone is a category error. Second, it depends on the chosen zero level, so it can be negative - a minus sign does not mean no energy, only that the body sits below the level you picked; the difference ΔE_p is what never depends on that choice, and processes spend only the difference. Third, gravity does work independently of the path, fixed by the height difference alone, W_G = −ΔE_p, and this is precisely the condition that lets a potential energy exist at all; friction by contrast accumulates along the path, more laps spend more, which is why there is no 'friction potential energy'. Elastic energy E_p = ½kx² follows the same logic: the spring force grows linearly with deformation, so the work is the triangle under the F-x graph (k is the stiffness, valid only inside the elastic limit). For scale: a 60 kg person going up to a 100 m rooftop gains about 5.9 × 10⁴ J, the same order as the chemical energy in one sugar cube, and each cubic metre of reservoir water falling 100 m hands over about 9.8 × 10⁵ J - hydropower is simply a bill for that difference. One boundary must be stated: mgh holds only while the height is tiny against Earth's radius; higher up you return to the exact gravitational form −GMm/r. Symbols: E_p gravitational potential energy, m mass, g gravitational acceleration, h the height above the chosen zero level.

oneLiner: 只有重力或弹力做功时，动能与势能之和保持不变。
oneLinerEn: With only gravity/elastic forces doing work, kinetic plus potential energy is constant.
detail: 守恒条件写作「只有重力或弹力做功」，注意它考的是功、不是受力清单：单摆的绳拉力、斜面与曲面的支持力自始至终都在，但因为永远与速度垂直、一个也不做功，于是机械能守恒。反过来，匀速下降的降落伞动能不变而势能不断减少，机械能显然不守恒，差额被空气阻力变成了热。绳子突然绷紧的瞬间、多数碰撞、人走路与骑车时体内化学能的介入，都会让「机械能」这一本账算不平，此时须改用总的能量守恒 ΔEₖ + ΔEₚ = W_其他（摩擦一项就是 −Q）。式子只有 ½mv₁² + mgh₁ = ½mv₂² + mgh₂，好处是完全不问路径与中间过程的力。两个判据写在数字里：20 m 高的光滑滑道，末端速度按 √(2gh) 约 20 m/s、合 72 km/h，而真实水滑道只跑到其大半，剩下的是摩擦的账；过山车的第一座提升丘必须是最高的，之后每一座都只能更低，否则车爬不过去——落差 60 m 理论上给出约 34 m/s。它与动能定理是同一件事的两副面孔：定理是普适标量式，任何过程都能上；守恒式只在条件成立时最省事，所以解题第一步永远是先问「除了重力和弹力，还有谁在做功」。
detailEn: The condition reads 'only gravity or spring force does work', and the test is about work, not about the list of forces: the string tension of a pendulum and the normal force of a slide are present the whole time, yet because they stay perpendicular to the velocity they do no work, so mechanical energy is conserved. Conversely, a parachute descending at steady speed keeps its kinetic energy while losing potential energy, so mechanical energy is plainly not conserved - the difference has been handed to the air as heat. A rope snapping taut, most collisions, and the chemistry inside walking or pedalling legs all make the mechanical account fail to balance, and then you must switch to the general one, ΔE_k + ΔE_p = W_other, with the friction term standing for −Q. The formula is only ½mv₁² + mgh₁ = ½mv₂² + mgh₂, and its virtue is that it never asks about the path or the forces along it. Two checks live in numbers: a 20 m frictionless chute ends at √(2gh), about 20 m/s or 72 km/h, while a real water slide reaches only the better part of that, the rest being friction's bill; and a roller coaster's first lift hill has to be its tallest, every later hill lower, or the train will not make it over - a 60 m drop would theoretically give about 34 m/s. This and the work-energy theorem are two faces of one thing: the theorem is the universal scalar form that handles any process, while conservation is the shortcut that pays only when its condition holds, so the first move in any problem is to ask 'besides gravity and the spring, who else is doing work?'

oneLiner: 系统不受外力时，总动量 p=mv 保持不变。
oneLinerEn: Without external force, total momentum p=mv is conserved.
detail: 动量 p = mv 是矢量，用守恒定律第一步是定正方向，负号代表反向而不代表「小」。守恒条件是系统不受外力或合外力为零；而碰撞、打击、爆炸这类过程内力远大于外力、时间又短，可以近似按守恒处理，这正是它比动能定理好用的场合。动量定理 I = Δp 把力与作用时间绑在一起（I = Ft，F–t 图下的面积即冲量），一切「缓冲」都是这条公式的工程：1 kg 的小球以 10 m/s 撞墙、以 8 m/s 弹回，动量变化的大小是 18 kg·m/s，而动能只少了 18 焦——矢量的改写道数与标量的差完全是两件事；若接触时间是 0.01 s，平均冲力达 1800 N（约相当于 180 kg 压上来），垫上泡沫把作用时间拉长到 0.1 s，力就降到 180 N，跳高垫、保险杠与包装泡沫买的都是这一个数量级（缓冲公式 F = Δp/t 就是这条定理改写的）。碰撞分三档：弹性碰撞动量与动能都守恒；一般非弹性碰撞只守恒动量；完全非弹性碰撞碰后共速、动能损失最大而动量一分不少。两个常用模型：等质量弹性正碰交换速度（牛顿摆与台球的直觉来源）；静止系统分开时的反冲与人船问题里质心不动，故 m₁v₁ = m₂v₂、位移也满足 m₁x₁ = m₂x₂。火箭是最漂亮的一例——它不靠推空气（见牛顿第三定律条），喷气速度一定时可得的速度增量按齐奥尔科夫斯基公式 Δv = v_e·ln(m₀/m₁) 走对数，质量比一加就得靠多级把干重扔掉。边界两处：守恒的根据是「内力不改总动量」，与牛顿第三定律等价；高速时 p 要换成 γmv，微观粒子仍守动量但不再有确定的轨道。式中 p 为动量，m 为质量，v 为速度。
detailEn: Momentum p = mv is a vector, so the first move with its conservation law is to fix a positive direction; a minus sign means reversed, not small. The condition is that the system feels no external force or that the net external force vanishes, and in collisions, impacts and explosions the internal forces dwarf the external ones over a very short time, so conservation applies approximately - which is exactly where it beats the work-energy theorem. The impulse-momentum relation I = Δp ties force to contact time (I = Ft, the area under the F-t graph being the impulse), and every cushioning device is its engineering (the cushion formula F = Δp/t is just this relation solved for force): a 1 kg ball hitting a wall at 10 m/s and rebounding at 8 m/s changes its momentum by 18 kg·m/s while losing only 18 J of kinetic energy - two quite different books - and if contact lasts 0.01 s the average force is 1800 N, roughly the weight of 180 kg piled on, whereas stretching that to 0.1 s with foam drops it to 180 N. High-jump mats, bumpers and packaging foam all buy that single order of magnitude. Collisions come in three grades: elastic ones conserve both momentum and kinetic energy; real inelastic ones conserve only momentum; perfectly inelastic ones leave the bodies moving together with the largest kinetic-energy loss and not one unit of momentum missing. Two staple models: an equal-mass elastic head-on collision swaps the velocities (the intuition behind Newton's cradle and billiards), and in recoil or the boat-and-person problem the centre of mass stays put, giving m₁v₁ = m₂v₂ and likewise m₁x₁ = m₂x₂. The rocket is the finest case - it does not push on air (see the third-law entry), and with a fixed exhaust speed the reachable velocity gain follows the Tsiolkovsky formula Δv = v_e ln(m₀/m₁), a logarithm, which is why stacking stages to shed dry mass is the only way around it. Two boundaries: the law rests on internal forces never changing total momentum, equivalent to the third law; and at high speed p becomes γmv, while microscopic particles still conserve momentum but no longer have orbits. Symbols: p momentum, m mass, v velocity.
